feeds.title: Laser Tech Blog
feeds.description: Since 1985, we've been creating laser-based speed and distance measurement instruments - leading the industry in the design and manufacturing of innovative solutions. At Laser Tech, we understand the need for precise measurements and accurate data are crucial and hence we develop the technology necessary to solve critical problems with greater ease.

feeds.title: Dipesh Shah » Measurement
feeds.description: Dipesh Shah shares his insights and info on various points concerning the topic of measurement. He also talks about topics like analytics, ecosystem, technology, data layer, and more. He is an experienced consultant helping brands grow, through connecting technology, data, analytics, and measurement together to deliver business value and results. He has a deep understanding of data and technology and how to make it work in the context of the business and marketing world.

feeds.title: ABB » Measurement & Analytics Blog
feeds.description: At ABB Measurement & Analytics Blog, our goal is to help make measurement & analytical technology selection, operation, and ownership easy - so you can focus on your business. Read our blog for regular insights from a globally leading technology expert, informed news from a range of industrial sectors, and in-depth profiles of leading measurement products from across our extensive fields of experience.
